judgments.target_text: as automotive OEMs move toward high-nickel cathode materials
judgments.value_text: The shift toward high-nickel cathode materials will increasingly require battery-grade lithium hydroxide.
judgments.summary: Livent's 2018 filing expressed a structural thesis that increasing high-nickel cathode adoption would increase the requirement for battery-grade lithium hydroxide.

metadata.semantic_guard: This is a structural demand thesis, not a dated near-term pace forecast. No exact demand date or volume is manufactured from the source.

judgments.value_text: Livent did not expect a meaningful change in demand for high-performance lithium hydroxide used in high-nickel cathode chemistries until late 2019 or early 2020 and reduced full-year volume and pricing forecasts accordingly.
judgments.summary: By 2019 Q1, Livent expected the meaningful high-nickel-driven hydroxide demand inflection later than its near-term planning had assumed and reduced full-year volume and pricing forecasts.

metadata.semantic_guard: The source supports a negative near-term timing/strength revision but does not withdraw the longer-run structural high-nickel-to-hydroxide thesis.
